notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 – Tent Trouble Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

 Version 1.1 of Toni Island Adventure launched yesterday, but we quickly found a bug that caused Toni to become invisible when entering his tent. This patch fixes the issue.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, especially to those who may have lost their save files with the last update. Thanks again for your patience and support!

If you run into any bugs, typos, or other issues, feel free to email us at hello@frolicstudio.fun.



– Guigo 🐾

Game Dev, Frolic Studio

notes.title: 🛠️ Upcoming Patch - Toni Island Adventure v1.1 Arrives August 6
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for playing Toni Island Adventure and for all the feedback we've received so far. We're currently working on the game's first patch, which will be released on August 6.

This update focuses on fixing bugs and making the experience smoother, especially for Steam Deck players.

If you run into any bugs, typos, or other issues, feel free to email us at hello@frolicstudio.fun.


✅ What to Expect in v1.1:


The Game Boy ROM file will be included with the game files

Improved control rebinding support for the Steam Deck

Fixed an issue with the stick NPC in Bauport that could cause Toni to get stuck

Increased invulnerability frames after getting hit • Fixed typos and text issues

Fixed a bug with a pizza delivery NPC that could stop progress in that quest

Smoothed out some hiccups in the last dungeon’s platforms

Fixed a bug that could cause the final boss to break in some situations


⚠️ Important Save File Warning:
Due to memory limitations from the Game Boy hardware, save files from version 1.0 will not work properly in version 1.1. If you want to keep your save or continue playing the original version, please back up your save file somewhere outside of the Steam folder before the update goes live (08/06).


🔍 Known Issues (Engine-related):
These issues come from the game engine and not from the game itself, but we’re doing our best to improve them.

Screen tearing and stuttering on high refresh rate monitors, especially on Windows


🔧 What's Next?
This patch should cover most of the important issues. We don’t plan to release frequent updates, but we will release a new patch if a major bug is found or something threatens player progress.

We’re also planning to add Steam achievements to the game. Since this requires some low-level programming work, it may arrive after this patch. That said, this addition won’t affect your save file, as it doesn’t involve changes to the game data itself.



Thanks again for being part of the launch and for all your support and understanding.

I'm really proud of this little game and happy to keep improving it with your help.



– Guigo 🐾
Game Dev, Frolic Studio

notes.title: New Demo Update Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a brand new version of the Toni Island Adventure demo — and it’s packed with exciting updates!

The game now runs on a Godot-based engine, which significantly reduces file size and should offer better performance on PC. This update also expands your journey beyond the Pawssport checkpoint — you'll now be able to explore Pomodorino Woods and venture up to Mt. Stracciatella, home of the mysterious Oracle.

Back in Bauport, a new building has appeared: the Community Museum, ready to be filled with the rarest gems and fish you can find later in game. And yes, the PawPhone is now fully functional, so you can make calls — a feature previously unavailable!

We’ve also addressed various bugs, fixed typos, and added small improvements throughout the game.

We hope you enjoy re-visiting Salamino Island one last time before the official launch — [strike]which is very close and should be announced soon[/strike] 👀🐾

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949126/264c5864bd0c2e165dd680d1f31fc173ccddcfea.png

🛠️ Changelog – Demo Update


 Game now runs on Godot
 Added character portraits to the opening cutscene
 Minor text edits in the opening cutscene
 Added new animations in the opening cutscene
 Minor bug fixes
 Fixed various misspelled texts
 Added the Colossal Pizza to the first dungeon
 New NPC in Bauport: The Mayor’s Secretary
 The PawPhone can now make calls
 New NPC in Marianara Beach: Tere (backer character)

notes.title: Toni Island Adventure Demo Update: Now Live!
notes.content:
Hola, Guau-migos! Toni Island Adventure’s demo is back, and we’ve made some exciting updates to make your journey even better! Here’s what’s new:


 New Language Option

Hola Guau-migos!: You can now experience Toni's adventure in Spanish (LATAM)!

 Improved Exploration

Paw-tographers at work: Our canine cartographers had a ruff time re-mapping the island! Check out the new and improved map in your PawPhone’s map app next time you explore.

 Gameplay Enhancements

What does this button do?: Buttons in dungeons now have clearer sprites to make them more understandable.
New HUD and Stats Screen: We’ve given our HUD and stats screen a fresh coat of paint with some cosmetic updates!

 Bug Fixes & Adjustments

Typos: We’ve tackled those pesky typos in the English language version. If you spot any remaining issues, let us know at help@frolicstudio.fun!
Pesky Bugs: Fixed a bug where players wouldn’t fall into holes if they had exactly 1 HP remaining.



🎥 Tune in Tomorrow!
Don’t miss the Latin American Games Showcase: The Game Awards Edition 2024!

Tomorrow, Dec. 10 @ 4 PM PT / 6 PM CT / 7 PM ET / 9 PM BRT

The LAGS's Official YouTube or Twitch channels (@LAGShowcase)
or at their Broadcast Partners: The Game Awards, IGN, and GameSpot

notes.title: ⚙️ Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
Patch Notes v1.0.5

  Adjustments in the Ancient Ruins of BauBau: It is no longer possible to get stuck, either accidentally or intentionally, on the rocks.
 Reset of 'sokoban' puzzles: Now, when pressing 'start', the player will return to the beginning of the challenge.
 NPC in the Ruins: The lost NPC now provides clear explanations on how to reset the puzzles if the player gets stuck.
 Improved inventory performance: Considerable reduction in response time, providing a smoother experience.
 Correction of typos: Minor errors have been fixed to improve text clarity. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949126/495c84b6d00778b1d3383e3e02c864560f8cf17d.png

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4 ⚙️
notes.content:
Patch Notes v1.0.4


 The game viewport is now 2x larger! You can appreciate every pixel of the adventure.
 One of the rocks in the first puzzle in the Ancient Ruins of BauBau has been altered to prevent players from getting stuck in the room.
 Fixed minor localization issues in both the English and Portuguese versions.
 Corrected discrepancies between the PawPhone map and the player's actual position.


Thank you very much for your collaboration and feedback!


Thanks to your help, we are making the Demo experience smoother and more enjoyable for everyone!

notes.title: English Language Issue Resolved
notes.content:
Language Download Issue Resolved

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the recent issue where the Portuguese version of the game was incorrectly downloaded as the default for all players. This has now been resolved, and the English version will be downloaded by default.

If you have already downloaded the game, please right-click on Toni Island Adventure DEMO in your Steam Library > Manage > General, and change the language to English.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949126/f1d952a950ac7e920555d6fd11597f0bef449277.jpg

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3 ⚙️
notes.content:
Patch v1.0.3 notes


 Fixed a bug that made the keyboard irresponsive if the caps lock key was active
 Fixed a bug that made Toni's sprite invisible by The Ancient Ruins of BauBau entrance, at night
 The amount of BUCKS is now being shown in the correct place in the Stats window
 Falling down a hole will now make Toni faint if he has 1HP or less


Thank you for your input and feedback, everyone!


Thanks to your reports we've been able to address these minor issues and make the demo experience as smooth as possible!

notes.title: Free Demo version now available.
notes.content:
Make room for a slice!

Toni Island Adventure's free demo version was launched this Thursday (09/27) and will be playable on Steam until November 10th.
Explore the first minutes of our pizza-eater canine hero's journey, but don't forget to make room for the full feast coming in Q1 2025!
We're thrilled and excited to be able to share a small piece of what we've been cooking until now.

Please feel free to tell us what you think about the game, share suggestions, and report any bugs/errors you may eventually encounter during your playtime through the form found at the end of the game's main menu. 

We hope you enjoy your time at Salamino Island!
